On swap market it is not a problem, because I can get currently opened positions tickers and retrieve open stop orders,
```
for ticker in open_positions:
    await update_open_stop_orders(user, market, ticker)
```
 while on spot such decision for limit sell orders obviously doesnt work. How is it better to handle that issue?
